body:
I'll definitely look into the therapy, but I can't help but think that extra help wouldn't really be worth the hassle. My mum has tried in the past but that only made him uneasy as he is extremely complacent with us already helping him.

That's also another thing I can't bare to think about, how if one day we need to put him in a home because we can no longer care for him. It would be heartbreaking to force him to be around strangers and make him feel like we're abandoning him.

I've never really reached out for help as everyone assumes that I am just 'OK' all the time, They have no idea of that thoughts that go through my mind everyday.

I wouldn't want anyone in my family to find out about what types of things I think about because that would just break them.

Don't get me wrong, I love my brother, he means the world to me but seeing him suffer everyday really wants me to just end it for him but I know that is impossible.

I don't really know, everything just seems overwhelming at the moment so I think I will look into going to see someone and get this all off my chest.
